# A second invoice for customer C001, posted and not paid.
#
# Read into the book q014_invoice_posted_paid.txt makes, once INV-001 has been
# unposted. GnuCash sees the payment that unpost left behind as C001's credit,
# so its own credit application can settle this invoice with it.
#
# What this fixture produces: INV-002, 100.00 CAD, posted to
# Assets:Accounts Receivable.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_orphan_gnucash_applied_to_another_invoice_is_no_orphan.py.
invoice "INV-002"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-002"
		accumulate: true
